name: Bloodmaster's Ring
summary: At the Bloodmaster's Ring, you report to Jezap after proving yourself against Twilight ogres. The Bloodmaster is ready to judge whether you belong.

sections.title: At the Ring
sections.body: The challenge at the Bloodmaster's Ring has brought you to Jezap, the ring's goblin. After you defeat the Twilight ogres, you report to him, with the Bloodmaster and Jezap watching. They are deciding whether you belong among those who approach the precipice of power.

faq.q: Who do I report to at the Bloodmaster's Ring?
faq.answer: You report to Jezap at the Bloodmaster's Ring.

faq.q: What did I do before coming here?
faq.answer: You smashed Twilight ogres that were judged weak.

faq.q: What is the Bloodmaster looking for?
faq.answer: The Bloodmaster is judging whether you belong at the precipice of power.
